verdict.rationale: DeepInfra hosts a Swagger UI at api.deepinfra.com/docs, built on its OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, with runnable try-it-out requests against the live API, plus a Mintlify API reference section. The probe 404s on deepinfra.com paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served on the api.deepinfra.com domain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that try-it-out works, and evidence of curated per-endpoint example payloads or code samples beyond the generic Swagger try-it-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: a vendor-hosted interactive explorer with runnable try-it-out requests against the live API
